method: Read actual learner and key prose/tables, all14 prior active contracts and actual cumulative registers; historical snapshot creates no teaching credit.
Personally viewed the primary image paths recorded below; independently checked lexical class, vowel quantity, stem alternations, endings, government, task-target senses and teaching limits.

Checked all691 actual logical display positions, including16 explicitly unassigned slots and5 two-word constructions.69 matrices also mechanically equal canonical displays; this equality is only a structural check.

Manually read actual116 learner form-output blanks and key answers by grammatical position, then checked exact route identities. Valid source alternatives were distinguished from compliance with an explicitly selected target.
Complete paradigms are model-derived where indicated; no claim that every cell has its own corpus attestation. Principal-parts reference rows confer no unassigned syntax.
Reviewed all three reader local-help sets, complete actual texts and keys against primary Cook159/162/163; reviewed proportional source156–157 and eleven bounded lexical frames.
